title: Merry Princess Clipart Set
author: poppymoondesign
description:
Step into a magical Christmas kingdom with Merry Princess, a whimsical collection of festive princesses, enchanted castles and adorable holiday characters!
This charming collection combines the magic of Christmas with a playful princess theme, featuring sweet princess characters, decorated Christmas trees, magical castles, a festive carriage, crowns, candy canes, Christmas lights and other seasonal details.
Merry princess is designed for anyone who loves the combination of princesses, Christmas and colourful storybook-style characters.
Create your own festive princess scenes, magical Christmas castles, holiday invitations, children’s artwork or seasonal products. The collection gives you plenty of individual elements to build completely different designs.
Whether you’re creating something for a Christmas princess party, children’s Christmas project, festive apparel or your Etsy shop, these illustrations are ready to add a little holiday sparkle. ✨
✨ WHAT’S INCLUDED
You will receive:
20 individual clipart images
PNG format
Transparent backgrounds
300 DPI
High-resolution artwork
Each image saved separately
Instant digital download
No physical product will be shipped
🎀 PERFECT FOR
These Christmas princess graphics are perfect for:
– Christmas sublimation designs
– T-shirt and sweatshirt designs
– Tote bags
– Stickers and sticker sheets
– Christmas cards
– Party invitations
– Birthday invitations
– Princess party decorations
– Christmas stationery
– Scrapbooking
– Digital planners
– Printable artwork
– Children’s crafts
– Classroom projects
– Christmas party decorations
– Nursery and kids’ designs
– Etsy digital products
– Seasonal digital projects
– Printable decorations
Thank you and happy Creating!
